patch_description: This version spends LP calls on batches of energy-ranked, topologically diverse proposals rather than following a single descent path. It starts from energy-ranked, diverse repaired candidates, then explores degree-preserving two-switches guided by LP bottleneck prices, supplemented by occasional three-link rotations and multi-switch kicks. An elite-but-diverse parent set and persistent duplicate tracking help balance intensification with exploration; the search stops cleanly when the LP budget is exhausted.
